messages:
maria_dev: Quick sync — I'm building a sandbox UX for rollout-time error-handling policies. Need input on two hard tradeoffs: how the console simulates degradations vs full failover, and what we persist for audit/replay. sample policy proto below. thoughts?

sam_ops: Love the idea. Two quick Qs: (1) default telemetry sampling rate? (2) do we persist full request/response or only metadata+inputs-to-reproduce? storage/cost concern. :thinking:

dave_prod: Prefer storing reproducible inputs + metadata (headers, route, model, decision_id) rather than raw PII. Keep a deterministic `replay_hash` so we can run dry-run in sandbox. For low-traffic routes 1% sampling OK, for critical routes 100%.

jen_ui: UX notes: console should have a `simulate` toggle at route-level, a timeline of decisions, and a +replay button that runs a dry-run against stored inputs. Filters: model, region, error-code, policy_version. Wireframes incoming. :eyes:

lia_sre: We also need clear mapping of error categories -> degrade modes. Example categories: `rate-limit`, `model-oom`, `infra-5xx`, `bad-input`. Map to `retry`, `cached_response`, `route_to-smaller-model`, `block`. This affects telemetry flags and how we mark audit events.

maria_dev: Sketch of the policy proto I'm imagining (toy):
```json
{
  "policy_version": "2026-04-12-a",
  "routes": {
    "/v1/generate": {
      "default": { "degrade_mode": "route_to-smaller-model", "sample_rate": 0.01 },
      "triggers": [
        { "error_pattern": "model_oom", "degrade_mode": "route_to-smaller-model", "sample_rate": 1.0 },
        { "error_pattern": "rate_limit", "degrade_mode": "cached_response", "sample_rate": 0.1 }
      ]
    }
  },
  "audit": { "store_decision": true, "redact_fields": ["user_prompt.pii"], "retention_days": 90 }
}
```

sam_ops: API naming bikeshed: use `policy_version` and let sandbox calls pass `simulate=true` as a query param. Also add `X-Decision-Id` header on responses so traces link to audit events.

dave_prod: Agree on `X-Decision-Id`. For privacy, implement redaction hooks before storing. Also: ensure replay includes a `dry_run_timestamp` and points to the exact code/config used (policy_version + runtime image tag).

deploy-bot: sandbox deployment queued — job id: sbx-2026-04-12-44. Status: queued.

jen_ui: Mockups: timeline should show `decision_id`, brief reason (e.g., "model_oom -> route_to-smaller-model"), sample_rate that triggered capture, and a replay button. We should also surface when a decision was simulated vs enforced. Also need a pre-save redaction step in the pipeline.

maria_dev: Proposed action items: 1) infra (@lia_sre) add `X-Decision-Id` header + storage TTL/retention config + redaction hooks. 2) runtime team (sam_ops/dave_prod) implement mapping table + deterministic `replay_hash` + policy_version tagging. 3) console (jen_ui) add simulate toggle + decision timeline + replay UI and filters. I'll draft an RFC with examples and required API fields. @sam_ops @jen_ui can you own the API/console bits?

lia_sre: :thumbsup: I'll own infra pieces (TTL, retention, redaction pipelines). Will open infra ticket with required storage estimates.

sam_ops: I'll take the runtime API contract. Will add `simulate=true` param and return `X-Decision-Id` and `X-Replay-Hash`.

jen_ui: Taking the console mockups + UX acceptance criteria. Will add wireframes to the RFC and include edge cases (multi-region replay, policy rollback).

maria_dev: Nice. One more UX question: should simulate mode write audit events marked `simulated=true` (but still allow replay)? My leaning: yes — we need to be able to replay simulated decisions without them affecting SLA metrics.

dave_prod: +1. Simulated decisions should not count toward SLO alerting. We still want them in audit for regression checks.

maria_dev: OK will make that explicit. I'll post RFC link here once drafted. Thanks all.
